openGraph.title: About Us | Auto-Talleres Orihuela
openGraph.description: Discover the history and expertise of Auto-Talleres Orihuela S.L.

hero.description: Our passion in every kilometre. At Auto Talleres Orihuela, we know first-hand what it means to depend on a vehicle as a working tool.

passion.titleLine1: A support point for those who keep the country
passion.paragraph1: At Auto Talleres Orihuela, S.L., we understand what it means to depend on a vehicle for your work. We are a support point for hundreds of hauliers, logistics companies and self-employed professionals who need to keep their vehicles in optimal condition.
passion.paragraph2: That responsibility is what motivates us to open our doors every morning with the same commitment as on the very first day.

roots.subtitle: The beginning of a family project.
roots.paragraph1: Our history began with Francisco Parres Sánchez, who founded this project with a very clear vision: to provide the Vega Baja region with a vehicle repair and maintenance service characterised by honesty, precision and a close relationship with our customers.
roots.paragraph2: What began as a family-run technical workshop has evolved over the years to become a benchmark for after-sales service in our region, while preserving the dedication and technical quality values on which we were founded.

facilities.paragraph1: Located in a strategic area on the Murcia-Alicante road, km 28, Orihuela, our fully equipped facilities allow us to respond immediately to our customers' needs.
facilities.paragraph2: Our work covers mechanical, electromechanical, braking and preventive maintenance needs for commercial and heavy-duty vehicles.
facilities.paragraph3: We take care of your vehicle so that you only have to focus on your route.

specialization.description: We focus 100% on after-sales technical service and the sale of original spare parts, backed by the highest quality standards in the industry.

vans.title: Mercedes-Benz Vans
vans.description: Comprehensive maintenance and original spare parts for combustion-engine vans such as Vito, Sprinter and Citan.

truck.title: Daimler Truck Spain
truck.description: Specialised assistance and official spare parts for Actros, Arocs, Atego and Unimog trucks.

buses.title: Daimler Buses
buses.description: Workshop support and original parts for Setra and Mercedes-Benz buses and coaches.

fuso.title: FUSO Trucks
fuso.description: Official technical service and spare parts for the FUSO Canter range of compact trucks.

customers.title: Our customers
customers.description: Hauliers and companies who trust us to keep their working vehicles in perfect condition.

team.title: Our team
team.description: Passionate, qualified and approachable professionals whose technical expertise ensures that your vehicle is in the best hands.
